metadata.scope: Native Global Hourly temperature and sea-level pressure ingestion

source.instrument_details_status: Not established by this extract; do not infer a specific sensor or calibration model
source.note: A published observational dataset, not raw instrument acquisition.

TMP.description: Encoded source temperature and QC pair; original text retained

temperature_c.description: Reported air temperature decoded from source; not claimed to be uncalibrated sensor output

SLP.description: Encoded source sea-level pressure and QC pair; original text retained; absent from some record types (e.g. SOD, SOM, SPECI without full obs)

sea_level_pressure_hpa.description: Reported sea-level pressure decoded from source; 99999 missing sentinel decoded to null; not subject to calibration or altitude reduction here

decode_temperature.operation: Split signed integer and QC code; +9999 becomes null, otherwise divide integer by 10. Preserve QC verbatim.

decode_slp.operation: Split unsigned 5-digit integer and QC code; 99999 becomes null, otherwise divide integer by 10 to obtain hPa. Preserve QC verbatim. SLP field is optional; absent rows emit no SLP decoded fields.

validation.notes: Range check uses ISD-documented 860–1090 hPa; no altitude reduction or calibration is applied

declare_source_utc.operation: Validate the native timestamp and make the documented UTC timezone explicit; no time shift.

assumptions.native_encoding: Input is native Global Hourly TMP/SLP, not a units-converted or reformatted export
assumptions.slp_optional: SLP field is present only for hourly surface reports (FM-12, FM-15, FM-16 etc.); daily summary (SOD, SOM) and some special reports omit it

calibration.status: Upstream processing not reproduced; no coefficients applied here

quality_rules.reading: Retain all rows including suspect and erroneous codes
quality_rules.publication: Not implemented; recognizing a QC code does not approve a measurement

validation_rules.scope: Nonempty input, required fields, types, UTC, range, unit and recognized QC codes only

reference_datasets.role: Real-source integration sample, not independent scientific ground truth

limitations: This manifest documents relationships; automatic impact graph generation from it is not implemented
No downstream aggregation or product validation
SLP is reported at sea level; station-elevation reduction is performed upstream by NOAA, not reproduced here
Range limits follow ISD-documented field bounds, not an independent climatological model
